messages:
Marta R.: Quick sync 1: spotted a few inconsistent microcopy choices while doing the onboarding guide sweep: 'API key' vs 'apiKey', and different ways we refer to model versions (model id, model name, model version). Opening a tiny PR to normalize.
Devon P.: Good catch. What's the proposed canonical phrasing?
Marta R.: Proposal in PR: use 'API key' in prose, use `apiKey` for code/SDK examples. For models, use 'model version' in prose and `model_id`/`modelId` in code depending on language.
Kai M.: That matches how our SDKs currently accept values. For Python examples: `model_id` snake_case; JS/TS: `modelId`.
Lena T.: One subtlety: the Console UI shows "Model" and a dropdown with version tags. We should align docs copy with the Console to avoid user confusion. Can someone confirm the exact Console label?
Devon P.: Console UX uses 'Model' label and then a 'Version' dropdown. I think 'model version' in docs maps cleanly.
Marta R.: I'll update the onboarding guide and the snippets. Also found three internal links that point to old anchor names after a refactor 17. Will include link fixes in the same PR to avoid followups.
Kai M.: For SDK snippets, can we add a small header comment that says: "Identifiers follow language conventions: camelCase for JS, snake_case for Python"? That would avoid churn.
Marta R.: Yes, adding a one-liner above each snippet and a single note in STYLE.md. Draft text in the PR: "Language snippet conventions: use camelCase for JS/TS identifiers (e.g., `modelId`), snake_case for Python (e.g., `model_id`). Prose should use natural language terms (e.g., 'model version')."
Devon P.: Minor nit: avoid saying "natural language" since we also have formal API names. Maybe: "Use plain English in prose; use SDK-style identifiers in code blocks."
Marta R.: Updated.
Lena T.: Can we add a tiny migration note for anyone consuming embedded snippets from the snippet registry? A 1-line reminder that some snippet ids changed, otherwise builds fail.
Kai M.: I'll run the snippet extractor after the PR lands and post any mismatch warnings in #devex.
Marta R.: Added a short migration example in the PR:
```py
# before (old snippet)
client.call(model_id="redwood-v1", api_key=API_KEY)
# after (new canonical names)
client.call(model_id="redwood-v1", api_key=API_KEY)
```
Marta R.: (the example is trivial here; mostly the header and variable names changed in some places)
Devon P.: Also, we should add a glossary line: "apiKey - the API credential shown as 'API key' in the Console." Might help searchers.
Marta R.: Done. Linked the glossary entry from onboarding and quickstart.
docs-bot: PR #4821 opened by @Marta R. - checklist: snippet headers, STYLE.md update, console-label check, link-fixes.
Kai M.: Running snippet registry check locally now. Will post any diffs. Expect 1-2 small fixes.
Lena T.: Thanks. If this lands today, I'll schedule a docs micro-release to pick up link fixes before the next staging build.
Marta R.: Plan: merge after Kai's sweep and Devon's review. Aiming for merge by EOD PST. If any Console wording needs changing, we can follow up with Product UX.
